title: Pet-Friendly 4BR • Sleeps 12 • Parking + 2 Decks
description:
Welcome to The Urban River—a stylish 4BR/4BA home in West Nashville with stunning skyline views. This spacious, pet-friendly retreat comfortably sleeps 12 and offers premium linens, smart TVs, a fully stocked chef’s kitchen, two balconies, and private garage parking. Walk to parks, shops, L&L Market, or Vanderbilt. Or ride less than 10 minutes to Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, and Nissan Stadium. Enjoy fast WiFi, self check-in, and a curated local guidebook to enhance your stay.

The space
New Listing: Discounted Rates Through Summer!

⭐ What You'll Love

🛏️ 4 beautifully designed bedrooms with plush, hotel-quality beds and Smart TVs in every room

🚿 4 full bathrooms stocked with luxury towels, toiletries, and double laundry areas for longer stays

🍳 Chef’s kitchen fully equipped for group meals — includes cookware, Keurig, blender & more

🌇 Two balconies, including a sunset-facing deck with skyline views of West Nashville

🐶 Pet-friendly with a small front yard and room to roam

🚗 Free parking for up to 7 vehicles, including garage — extremely rare for Nashville!

👶 Family-ready with high chair, Pack ’n Play, and kid-friendly touches

🛋️ Thoughtfully furnished — no “rental-grade” decor here; every piece is curated

⚡ Fast Wi-Fi (100+ Mbps) — ideal for remote work or streaming

🔐 Self check-in, keypad access, and 24/7 guest support

📍 Location, Location

Tucked in Sylvan Heights, a vibrant and walkable neighborhood just:

🎓 5–7 minutes to Vanderbilt, Belmont, and TSU

🎶 8 minutes to Broadway, Music Row, and The Gulch

🏟️ 10 minutes to Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, and Ascend Amphitheater

🛍️ Steps to L&L Market, McCabe Park, coffee shops, and boutique dining

✈️ Easy access to I-40 and I-440, under 20 minutes to BNA Airport

Perfect for shows, sports, weddings, work trips, or weekend getaways.

🎁 Extras Included

📘 Curated local guidebook with our favorite restaurants, shops, hikes, and hidden gems

📺 Streaming-ready Smart TVs — log in to Netflix, Hulu, Disney+ and more

🧂 Fully stocked with kitchen basics, hair dryers, ironing board, and cleaning supplies

🏠 Zoned + licensed for short-term rental in Nashville — book with confidence

Whether you're planning a family vacation, girls’ trip, couples weekend, or a work-from-anywhere escape, The Urban River offers the space, location, and style to make it special.

This isn’t just another rental — it’s your home base for an unforgettable Nashville experience.

✨ Come settle in, kick back, and live like a local!
